grammar.title: Simple present (presente simple)
grammar.explanation:
Usamos el presente simple para hablar de **rutinas** y cosas que hacemos siempre.
Con **he, she, it** el verbo lleva **-s** o **-es**.

examples.en: I get up at six. My sister gets up at seven.
examples.es: Yo me levanto a las seis. Mi hermana se levanta a las siete.

examples.en: My father goes to work by bus.
examples.es: Mi papá va al trabajo en bus.

grammar.tip: Verbos que terminan en *-ch, -sh, -o, -x* llevan **-es**: *watches, brushes, goes*. Y *have* cambia a **has**.

grammar.title: Negatives and questions: do / does
grammar.explanation:
Para negar usamos **don't** (I, you, we, they) o **doesn't** (he, she, it) + verbo **sin -s**.
Para preguntar ponemos **Do** o **Does** al inicio.

rows: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

examples.en: Does your mother work? Yes, she does.
What time do you go to bed?

grammar.tip: Con *does* o *doesn't* el verbo NO lleva -s: *Does she play…?* (no *Does she plays…?*).

grammar.title: Telling the time
grammar.explanation:
Preguntamos **What time is it?** y respondemos **It's…**.
Para decir *a las* usamos **at**: *at seven o'clock*.

examples.en: What time is it? It's nine thirty.
examples.es: ¿Qué hora es? Son las nueve y media.

examples.en: I have lunch at twelve o'clock.
examples.es: Almuerzo a las doce en punto.

grammar.tip: Usa **in the morning** (mañana), **in the afternoon** (tarde) y **in the evening / at night** (noche).

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency
grammar.explanation: Dicen **con qué frecuencia** hacemos algo. Van **antes** del verbo, pero **después** de *am/is/are*.

examples.en: I am never late for school.
examples.es: Nunca llego tarde a la escuela.

examples.en: My brother usually plays soccer on Saturday.
examples.es: Mi hermano usualmente juega fútbol los sábados.

grammar.tip: Con **never** no se usa *don't*: *I never watch TV* (no *I don't never…*).

reading.title: José's routine
reading.instructions: Lee el texto y responde las preguntas.
reading.text: My name is José and I live in a small town near Rivas. On school days I wake up at five o'clock. I take a shower, get dressed and have breakfast with my grandmother. I walk to school with my cousin. Classes start at seven and finish at twelve. In the afternoon I help my father on the farm. After that, I do my homework. We have dinner at six thirty. I usually go to bed at nine. On Sundays I play baseball with my friends.
